title: Commercial Rent in Pondicherry: Are You Undercharging?
description: Shop and office rents in Pondicherry change street by street. How to tell if your commercial property is undercharging, and what to do about it.
h1: Commercial rent in Pondicherry: how to know if you are undercharging
lead: Many shop owners in Pondicherry collect the rent they agreed years ago, because raising it feels awkward. The gap between that number and the street rate is money lost every month.
wa: Hi, I read your guide and have a question about my property in Pondicherry

paras: A tenant who has traded for years rarely volunteers a higher rent, and an owner who does not live nearby rarely asks. Agreements without escalation clauses freeze the rent. Meanwhile the street changes: footfall, parking and nearby businesses all move the market.

blocks.h: How to find the market rent
bullets: Look at what similar premises on the same street are asking now, not their old rents
Compare size, floor, frontage and parking like for like
Check whether the lease has an escalation or review clause
Ask what the tenant’s business earns; a busy shop can afford more
Allow for vacancy: a slightly lower rent with a reliable tenant can beat a high rent and a gap

blocks.h: Raising the rent without losing the tenant
paras: Do it at renewal, give notice early and explain the reason with evidence. A fair increase backed by what neighbouring properties charge is usually accepted. We negotiate rent revisions for owners as part of [property management](/nri-property-management-pondicherry), at no extra charge.
Our [free rental audit](/free-rental-audit) compares your rent with comparable properties nearby and puts the gap in rupees.
